documented_probe: C-1ea268be (expose the recovered key as a 32-bit unsigned value through the required calling convention): covered here at hard; hidden keys include 0xDEADBEEF and 0xFFFFFFFF so a signed/wrapped or narrower return fails the exact uint32 comparison, and the verifier calls recover_key through its own ctypes driver on fresh fixtures.
notes: Analytic key recovery (inverting the documented bijection) rather than brute force, exact bit-level C implementation, robust hex/comment parsing, malformed-input handling returning 0, and the fixed calling convention checked via a compiled driver. Hidden cases vary keys (incl. top-bit-set), pair counts, payload lengths, and one malformed file.
